name: A new CoA-class character knows only the baseline languages its race can learn (#7588)
contract: AscensionLiveBaseline::Skills for the Starcaller (class 26) holds Common 98, Orcish 109 and Darnassian 113 at 300/300, captured from a night elf. SkillRaceClassInfo limits Darnassian to night elves (RaceMask 0x8) and allows Common and Orcish for every race. Both characters are created through the normal creation handler, whose Player::Create runs OnPlayerCreateInitialItems and InitializeLiveBaseline; skills are read after login. A tauren Starcaller (race 6) must not know Darnassian but keeps Common, which playercreateinfo_skills does not give tauren, so only the baseline grants it. A night elf Starcaller (race 4) keeps Darnassian.
